chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
If a man says to another man, ‘Come, I will improve your sale,’ then profit becomes forbidden for him.

key_terms.أَحْسِنْ: improve; here, to better or alter the sale offer
key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: a man; the person initiating the statement
key_terms.الرِّبْحُ: profit; the gain earned from the transaction
key_terms.بَيْعَكَ: your sale; the transaction being discussed

ai.seo_question: When does profit in a sale become forbidden in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning improper interference in a sale and the unlawfulness of taking profit through such conduct. It emphasizes fairness and restraint in trade, and indicates that profit gained in this manner is haram.
